passed_checks: Supabase RLS: All created tables have Row Level Security enabled
OWASP MASVS: Cleartext HTTP traffic blocked on Android
OWASP MASVS: iOS App Transport Security intact
OWASP MASVS: Capacitor config cleartext disabled
PCI DSS SAQ A: No raw card data forms found in custom UI components

findings.title: Excessive Public Grants to 'anon' Role
findings.description: GRANT ALL ON ALL TABLES to anon allows unauthenticated database control if RLS is omitted on any future table.
findings.remediation: Restrict anon permissions to SELECT only, or rely on explicit role-based grants.

findings.title: PostgreSQL View Missing 'security_invoker = true'
findings.description: View in 20260714084846_add_reviews_table.sql (line 35) does not specify 'WITH (security_invoker = true)'. In Postgres, this defaults to security definer behavior, potentially bypassing RLS of underlying tables.
findings.remediation: Define view with 'CREATE VIEW ... WITH (security_invoker = true) AS SELECT ...';

findings.title: Android Backup Enabled (MASVS-STORAGE-2)
findings.description: android:allowBackup is set to 'true'. This allows adb backup extraction of app private storage, preferences, and session tokens.
findings.remediation: Set android:allowBackup='false' or define android:dataExtractionRules / android:fullBackupContent to exclude sensitive tokens.

findings.title: Missing iOS NSCameraUsageDescription
findings.description: @capacitor/camera is installed, but Info.plist lacks 'NSCameraUsageDescription', triggering App Store review rejection or app crash on permission prompt.
findings.remediation: Add '<key>NSCameraUsageDescription</key><string>UMANI needs camera access to capture farm profiles, harvests, and AgriReels.</string>' to Info.plist.

findings.title: Missing iOS NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription
findings.remediation: Add '<key>NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription</key><string>UMANI uses your location to discover nearby farms and agricultural experiences.</string>' to Info.plist.

findings.title: Missing Content Security Policy (CSP)
findings.description: index.html does not declare a Content-Security-Policy meta tag, leaving the web client vulnerable to script injection and cross-site scripting (XSS).
findings.remediation: Add a Content-Security-Policy meta tag restricting default-src, script-src, style-src, and connect-src (Supabase, CDN).

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy Meta Tag
findings.description: index.html does not declare a Referrer-Policy, potentially leaking internal URL paths and parameters to third-party CDNs.

findings.title: Unsanitized dangerouslySetInnerHTML (OWASP A03: Injection)
findings.description: dangerouslySetInnerHTML used without visible DOMPurify sanitization in src/components/ui/chart.tsx.
findings.remediation: Always sanitize untrusted HTML with DOMPurify.sanitize() before rendering.

findings.title: Vulnerable Dependencies Found (3 Critical, 23 High)
findings.description: npm audit identified 3 critical, 23 high, 8 moderate, and 2 low vulnerabilities in node_modules.
findings.remediation: Run 'npm audit fix' or update affected dependencies (e.g., maplibre-gl, tar, nanoid) to secure versions.
